title: Blocking Calls, Threads and the GIL
summary: A synchronous call freezes every task on the loop, and the GIL keeps threads from running Python in parallel. Decide between the loop, to_thread, process and interpreter pools and free-threaded builds, and see why none of them run in this browser sandbox.
